Initial release of smyx-leaf-aging-fall-prediction-analysis:

- Predicts houseplant leaf aging and fall risk within 3–7 days using daily time-series images and AI vision for color, gloss, and petiole angle analysis.
- Distinguishes normal vs. stress-induced leaf drop; provides daily aging reports and proactive care alerts.
- Includes strict open-id acquisition rules to access prediction and history features.
- Delivers direction-only care suggestions (e.g., increase humidity) with no chemical dosage advice.
- Supports smart planter and gardening app integration for refined care recommendations.
- Users can query and display historical leaf aging/fall reports in structured Markdown tables with direct report links.
